synopsis: The ISO 3450x standards support a mature road-vehicle scenario-based structure encompassing functional, logical and concrete scenarios, ODD taxonomies, scenario catalogs and parameterised generation, alongside ASAM OpenX specifications [f7410]. The glossary traces the three-level scenario abstraction to PEGASUS, from which it later entered ISO 3450x [f15697]. However, acceptance of these road-vehicle methods for an earth-moving collision-avoidance function remains uncertain, so road-sector maturity does not establish their acceptance for this application [f4315, f7410].

relations.note: Traces the three-level scenario abstraction in ISO 3450x to PEGASUS.
Qualifies road-sector maturity with uncertain acceptance for earth-moving collision avoidance.
